When: Within ninety (90) calendar days from the date of contract award. Where: American Center, U.S. Consulate General Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Why: To modernize the Center's technological capability with high-end American brand /equivalent hardware that projects a premium, high-tech "American look and

ling flawless technical delivery for public diplomacy programming. Goal: Deploy flexible, multi-modal AV and computing infrastructure that supports formal briefings, large public events, and STEM/makerspace programming. Target Audience: Guests of U.S. Consulate General Chennai, VIP/ executive stakeholders, technical teams, and American Center program attendees & visitors. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. The GUI shall be designed to allow an operator with basic TDL knowledge to achieve proficiency on core tasks in no more than three (3) standard working days. nual data entry. 3.1.3 Data and Issue Management: • 3.1.3.1 Management of TDL Differences: The software shall allow users to capture, document, and grade deviations from a standard TDL baseline directly within a platform's implementation record. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. Scope: To procure secured shielding cabinets for radioactive sources with specific interior dimensions and shielding materials. 1.1 Background: Current facilities do not support storage of the required sample sources and operations are moving to a new building without existing storage infrastructure.
